Records the four-statement table (exists/unique/selectable/ratified) as binding, the 'minimal under the tested criterion' vs 'minimal canonical operation set' terminology as binding pending a future FA-4/BA-3 ratification act, and three named findings-artifacts: AF-F-31 (Reject tension, an architecture issue not an operation-set defect, with Reject's typing as prior decision P-1), AF-F-32 (the A6 crossing, notable because the prior A6 witness was a tautology while this one could fail and did), AF-F-33 (the oderive.py '14-forced/18-upper' result is PROPOSED not DERIVED and may not be cited as mathematical evidence). A second part (after '#') is a separate reviewer's endorsement of the procedural discipline, proposing a strict three-way comparison framework (Derivation claim / Independent falsification result / Canonical consequence, the last classified on a RATIFIED->FORMALLY DERIVED->COMPUTATIONALLY VERIFIED->PROPOSED->OPEN ladder) for reconciling the falsification report when it arrives, an eight-question decision table, and explicit resistance to a fourth 'just pick the most sensible registry' path that would undo the established discipline.
contribution_assessment: Primary governance-process artifact recording the formal artifact IDs (AF-F-31/32/33) for the three most important findings from the operation-registry derivation, and proposing a durable reconciliation methodology (the three-way comparison and the five-rung epistemic-status ladder) for handling the upcoming independent falsification report without collapsing its findings prematurely into ratification.

summary: The commissioned independent falsification review (GN-82/GN-83, clause C-8) of the operation-registry derivation. Verifies file integrity (md5 matches) and byte-identical re-execution of all five scripts under a fresh Python 3.13.2. Grades each gate: AC-0 (earned right to propose) PASS; AC-1 (candidate-universe completeness) FAIL -- finds a materially incomplete universe via four independently-verified primary-source items (an uncited 24-operation Question-15 taxonomy, the live operation 'unask' under open decision ND-282-1, a reading ceiling three steps short at 281 when steps 282-284 exist, and uncited step 260/261 operation enumerations including Deduplicate); AC-2 through AC-6 PASS WITH FINDINGS. Produces 26 numbered findings (IR-F-1..IR-F-26: 6 RED, 10 AMBER, 9 GREEN, roughly), most critically refuting the derivation's central 'all six registries are inconsistent' claim (IR-F-1: Reject's cited 'specification' is only a provisional 'possible semantics' in step 256.11, and the model's encoding is strictly more permissive than that source) and its 'I-12 bypass' structural discovery (IR-F-4: no rung is actually skipped; the path exists only because of an undeclared hardcoded modelling choice). Recommends terminal verdict D, but grounded in underdetermination rather than the derivation's claimed inconsistency, and adds an eleventh prior decision P-11 ('what is the operation universe, and what act closes it') as prior to all of P-1..P-10.
contribution_assessment: The single most rigorous and load-bearing critical artifact in the batch regarding the operation-registry gap: a genuinely adversarial, independently-reproduced review that both confirms the derivation's strongest results (byte-identical reproduction, the D_mandatory bijection, the A6-crossing Commit rule, all 13 ratified-forcing anchors) and substantially weakens its two most dramatic claims (the Reject inconsistency and the I-12 bypass), while adding a new and arguably more fundamental finding (AC-1 FAIL: the candidate universe itself is demonstrably incomplete, adding P-11 as prior to all ten previously-named decisions).

summary: Deliverable 5 of commission GN-79/GN-80: the commissioner's decision package assembled per GN-85's fixed procedure from the derivation and the independent review, recommending (never deciding). Presents a mandatory three-way-comparison table per claim (derivation claim / falsification result / canonical consequence with rung and required raising authority), an eight-question answer table (six minimal registries mechanically reproducible but not reliable as computed values; not shown genuinely non-equivalent; a smaller registry not excluded; all 13 capabilities genuinely entailed; Sigma/Q_t genuinely irrelevant; Reject's canon-compatibility UNDETERMINED not incompatible; the A6 crossing genuine but scoped to an experimental source; no unique canonical registry established), the recommended terminal verdict D (agreed by both lanes, on the reviewer's underdetermination ground rather than the derivation's inconsistency ground), three permitted next moves (A: resolve prerequisites and rerun -- 'the only move the evidence supports'; B: ratify a unique registry -- unavailable; C: record as an open architectural decision -- available but discards Task 2's result) with a fourth move ('the six candidates are good enough, choose one') explicitly named FORBIDDEN by GN-85, and a registration list of new items (P-11, IR-F-2/4/5, AF-F-31 recharacterization, the step-ceiling correction). Includes the commissioner's own admitted spot-check error (a grep pattern that missed the actual step-284 filename), self-flagged as the same failure class the programme keeps catching.
contribution_assessment: The terminal governance synthesis artifact of the entire operation-registry commission arc in this batch: it formally reconciles the derivation and the independent review per the pre-fixed GN-85 procedure, cleanly separates 'recommended' from 'decided', and is the source of the explicit, named-forbidden fourth disposition path that would otherwise tempt premature closure.

summary: A purely diagrammatic elaboration (14 mermaid flowcharts/state-diagrams/Gantt charts, no prose theory or HPA verdict) of the Step 25J six-phase pipeline (Observe/Sanjaya -> Assess/Arjuna -> Transform/Krishna -> Guide/Zero-Lord-Sarathi -> Decide/Arjuna -> Learn), giving each phase a detailed step breakdown with concrete field-level record schemas: Artifact (id, source, content, content_type, acquired_at, method, context, provenance), SourceObservation, SemanticInterpretation (entities, dimensions, values, relationships, confidence 0.0-1.0, alternatives), Proposition, CandidateAssertion, Evidence (relation_type supports/contradicts/qualifies, quality dimensions reliability/relevance/currency/independence/completeness), Epistemic State Sigma (acquisition/support/resolution/validity/conflict as small enumerated value sets), Assertion, and History records -- plus a data-flow diagram, a complete state machine, a five-layer system architecture diagram (Identity/Knowledge/Processing/Governance/External), and a Gantt-style 'Phase Timing Diagram' assigning specific wall-clock durations (0.5-1.0s) to each step with no stated basis.
contribution_assessment: A theory-lane elaboration of Step 25J into concrete, closely-typed record schemas (the most specific field-level proposal for Artifact/Observation/Evidence/EpistemicState/Assertion/History structures seen in this batch) and a five-layer system architecture; its Phase Timing Diagram assigns specific illustrative wall-clock durations with no measurement or justification, which should not be read as an empirical claim.

summary: The full commissioning prompt (predating and mandating S1993's independent falsification review) instructing an independent verification authority to attack the operation-registry derivation. Establishes the DERIVED != VERIFIED != AUTHORIZED != RATIFIED != CANONICAL separation and the four-statement status table; requires independent (not merely rerun) reconstruction of tests; details AC-1 through AC-6 procedures including a ten-attack adversarial suite (A: smaller registry, B: different decomposition, C: different primitive boundary, D: hidden derived operation, E: hidden state dependency, F: hidden evidence dependency, G: replay determinism, H: rejection-semantics assumptions, I: A6 authority-boundary crossing, J: invariant compatibility); mandates a CLAIM->SUPPORTING PREMISE->EXACT SOURCE->LOGICAL CONSEQUENCE entailment format with explicit flagging of 'later constructions being projected backward as though they were earlier canonical requirements'; specifies six required deliverable documents; sets a strict PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/OPEN/BLOCKED/NOT TESTABLE verdict vocabulary across ten dimensions; lists nine mandatory stop conditions; and closes with the seven-stage pipeline discipline DERIVE -> FALSIFY -> DECIDE -> RATIFY -> DEFINE TRANSFORMATIONS -> IMPLEMENT -> TEST, with an explicit warning against skipping a stage.
contribution_assessment: The primary methodological/governance artifact that specifies the independent-review mandate later executed (with some but not all of its prescribed rigor -- e.g. the review largely reused/re-ran the derivation's own scripts rather than fully independently reconstructing tests as instructed) in OPERATION-REGISTRY-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.md (S1993); its ten-attack adversarial taxonomy (A-J) and its entailment-format discipline are reusable methodological content beyond this specific commission.

summary: The commissioner-assembled terminal ten-dimension verdict (per the HPA's §14/§15/§18 mandate from S1997) synthesizing the derivation and the independent review into fixed-vocabulary verdicts: Completeness FAIL, Minimality PARTIAL, Uniqueness FAIL (count itself OPEN), Canonical selectability BLOCKED, Sigma/Q_t independence PARTIAL, Invariant compatibility PARTIAL-with-one-OPEN, Authority/evidence compatibility PARTIAL, Replayability FAIL, Rejection semantics NOT TESTABLE, Governance status NOT ESTABLISHED. Applies the HPA's own pre-fixed acceptance gate mechanically: since AC-1 failed, the gate's own rule ('if any fails, the operation registry is NOT VERIFIED') yields THE OPERATION REGISTRY IS NOT VERIFIED, and the alternate 'VERIFIED NON-UNIQUENESS' outcome is also unavailable (requires all six gates to pass) so the honest statement is 'non-uniqueness is REPORTED, not VERIFIED'. States that no second falsification pass can change this determination since completeness is a property of the candidate universe, not of the testing. Answers the six final questions and concludes disposition D (blocked by pre-existing architectural decisions) with the ordering correction that P-11 is prior to all of them.
contribution_assessment: The terminal, most authoritative-in-form (though still explicitly unratified) status statement of the entire operation-registry commission arc (GN-79 through GN-86) in this batch: it mechanically applies the HPA's own pre-committed acceptance-gate rule to reach a definitive NOT VERIFIED determination, and is the single artifact that most crisply demonstrates the governance discipline of separating a rigorous negative/conditional result from either acceptance or rejection of the underlying work.

The second half is a full new commissioning prompt, 'STEP 284 — RESOLVE THE PRECONDITIONS FOR A CANONICAL OPERATION ALGEBRA', explicitly forbidding further operation-discovery/selection/ratification/book-editing, requiring reconstruction of P-11 (operation-universe closure) status, re-examination of P-1/AF-F-31 (Reject) and the A6/Article-8.3 boundary, a four-layer RATIFIED/AUTHORIZED/FORMAL-DERIVED/PROPOSED-OPEN classification discipline, a dependency graph for the canonical operation registry, six required deliverables, and the extended pipeline discipline PRECONDITIONS -> DERIVE -> FALSIFY -> DECIDE -> RATIFY -> TRANSFORMATIONS -> IMPLEMENT -> TEST.
contribution_assessment: Primary governance-process artifact recording an explicit duplicate-work-avoidance discipline (GN-87) and commissioning the next programme phase (Step 284) that directly answers the independent review's P-11/P-1/Art.8.3 findings; also notable for the commissioner's self-attributed process fault (under-specifying 'reconstruct independently' as 're-run the scripts').

summary: A self-styled 'HPA Response' (self-attested reviewer roles) evaluating an unincluded document's proposal to integrate Distribution Theory (Dirac delta/step function/singular support/convolution) and Fourier Analysis (frequency domain/spectral decomposition) into KnowledgeOS's Zero/Lord/Sarathi lenses. Endorses the gap-detection and pattern-identification mappings as correct, but rejects two specific technical proposals: treating uncertainty as a Gaussian probability distribution (citing 'Step 282 (F21) demonstrated that removing probability breaks 0 of 13 mandatory constructs' as evidence probability is not foundational) and using Fourier extrapolation for prediction (rejected explicitly on the Gita's non-attachment/Karma-Yoga principle, not on a technical objection alone, though a technical objection -- 'knowledge is not a periodic signal' -- is also given). Supplies corrected Python sketches (EpistemicDistribution, EpistemicFourierAnalyzer with pattern identification but explicitly no prediction method) and closes with a self-attested verdict 'ACCEPTED WITH CORRECTIONS'.
contribution_assessment: Notable for using a philosophical/religious analogy (the Gita's Karma-Yoga non-attachment principle) as an explicit stated ground for a technical architecture decision (rejecting Fourier-based prediction), alongside a separate, more conventional technical objection; also references an external empirical/computational finding (Step 282 F21: removing probability breaks 0 of 13 mandatory constructs) as evidence that probability is not foundational to KnowledgeOS.

summary: A two-part strategic/methodological synthesis assessing overall programme status after Step 284's commissioning. Part 1 assesses the book as ~60-70% structurally complete (Parts I-VI), states the programme is 'much closer to having a book than an implementable KnowledgeOS specification', diagrams the canonical implementation chain as severed at Operations/Transformations, proposes a five-gate roadmap to implementability (Gate 1 canonical theory boundary/Step 284; Gate 2 canonical operation algebra; Gate 3 transformation semantics delta:KxOperation->K'; Gate 4 implementation contract V.1-V.10; Gate 5 real-system empirical validation, citing '15 of 24 constructs have no real-environment observation'), a three-voice book structure (canonical/engineering/historical), and a 13-stage canonicalization pipeline. Part 2 (after a '#' divider) introduces a tripartite gap taxonomy that 'must not be merged': Derivation gaps (why does a construct exist -- exposing that some 'derived' claims were hand-authored tables, and the derived/proposed/authorized/ratified distinction was not consistently maintained), Definition gaps (what exactly IS each construct -- citing Q_t existing in two incompatible senses, an inquiry register outside K vs a legacy component inside K, and Evidence appearing as both a 3-field and 9-field structure), and Architecture gaps (how constructs behave/compose in an executable system -- Operations/Transformations/state-transition/authority-boundary/evidence/governance/implementation-mapping/empirical-observability gaps). Proposes a single controlled 'KNOWLEDGEOS-DERIVATION-DEFINITION-ARCHITECTURE-GAP-MATRIX' artifact with 12 columns per construct, classified on a seven-value RATIFIED/AUTHORIZED/FORMAL-DERIVED/TESTED/PROPOSED/OPEN/BLOCKED scale.
contribution_assessment: A structurally important cross-cutting methodological artifact: it names and formalizes the tripartite Derivation/Definition/Architecture gap distinction (a new conceptual framework not reducible to the operation-registry thread alone), documents two concrete definitional contradictions in the corpus (double-meaning Q_t; 3-field vs 9-field Evidence), and proposes a durable classification instrument (the gap matrix) plus a four-way discipline (discussed/defined/derived/ratified) for distinguishing epistemic status going forward.

summary: A self-styled 'HPA Comprehensive Synthesis' (self-attested reviewer roles, 'Status: COMPLETE') that re-maps S2001's tripartite Derivation/Definition/Architecture gap taxonomy onto Gita Chapters 4/5/6 respectively, restates the same concrete issues (competing O universes, Q_t double-meaning, 3-field vs 9-field Evidence, no canonical operation registry) with a Gita verse cited as justification for each, proposes formal 'closure conditions' for each gap category (Derivation closure requires lineage+necessity-proof+formal-status per construct; Definition closure requires canonical name+type+pre/postconditions+invariants; Architecture closure requires operation registry+transformation semantics+authority boundary+evidence model+governance model+implementation mapping+empirical observability), sketches missing formal definitions for a four-operation-type registry (state-changing/state-observing/governance/evidence, each mapped to a Gita concept), transformation semantics delta:KxOperationxPolicyxAuthority->K'xOutcome, an authority-boundary chain, an Evidence 7-tuple, and a Governance 4-tuple, and closes claiming 'The KnowledgeOS theory is formally closed at the declared scope' while simultaneously listing all three gaps as OPEN and proposing Steps 285-288 to close them.
contribution_assessment: Largely a Gita-chapter re-narration of S2001's already-captured gap taxonomy and findings; its one notable addition is an internal tension between its closing claim ('the KnowledgeOS theory is formally closed at the declared scope') and its own explicit listing of the Derivation/Definition/Architecture gaps as OPEN in the same section -- another instance of this batch's recurring self-attested-completeness pattern sitting uneasily alongside its own acknowledged gaps, on the same day the parallel operation-registry commission reaches a rigorous NOT VERIFIED determination (S1998).

summary: The Step 284 deliverable (GN-88/GN-89/GN-90) resolving the Reject/P-1 question to its sharpest form via independent read-only primary-text reconstruction. Establishes: FA-1 §2's ratified text already types the REJECTED-reaching act as governed and never silent; REJECTED occurs 0 times in v0.2/v0.1 and enters the Final Architecture only through D-FA-1; I-12 is ratified-scoped to the admission axis only, with REJECTED explicitly off that axis; Article 7 states no source-status guard at all (a repo-wide 'guard'/'precondition' search returns exactly one unrelated hit); step 256.11 explicitly and twice denies being a specification; exactly three mutually incompatible typings of Reject exist (epistemic act/governance transition/decision producer) plus one explicit refusal-to-type; and no governance act (24 ledger hits, all classified) ever typed Reject. Concludes: (Y-1) a registry must contain a governed-and-never-silent REJECTED-reaching operation, derivable now without resolving P-1; (Y-2) the specific conflict AF-F-31 alleges does NOT actually obtain, since it requires reading a self-declared non-specification as a specification, and reclassifies the situation as SEMANTIC UNDERDETERMINATION with a governance consequence, not an inconsistency between ratified propositions; (Y-3) P-1 is bounded -- it blocks only minimality/uniqueness/core-membership/invariant-compatibility claims quantifying over Reject's exact arity/codomain/guard, not the existence obligation itself. Verdict: P-1 OPEN, not resolved here, standing before the HPA alongside the registered AF-F-31.
contribution_assessment: The terminal, most precise analysis in this batch of the single most load-bearing sub-finding of the entire operation-registry arc (the Reject/AF-F-31 tension): it goes beyond IR-F-1's refutation by reclassifying the underlying situation with a positive existence claim (Y-1: a governed REJECTED-reaching operation IS required) alongside the negative claim (Y-2: no actual ratified inconsistency exists), and precisely bounds P-1's blocking scope (Y-3) rather than leaving it as an undifferentiated open question.
